statements.impact_statement: RUSTSEC-2026-0372: the zvariant_derive crate is no longer maintained as a separate crate; its derive macros are provided by zbus from 6.0.0. RustSec marks every zvariant_derive release as affected, reports no vulnerability in it and lists no patched version: https://rustsec.org/advisories/RUSTSEC-2026-0372.html and https://github.com/z-galaxy/zbus/issues/2043. We listed the contents of every build-dev apk in the Alpine 3.23 index of the DHI Alpine repository, for x86_64 and aarch64 (91 versions from 2.6.4-r0 to 2.30.0-r0, 181 apks, with 2.6.4-r0 published for aarch64 only), each checked against its index checksum. The repository lists 2.19.1-r1 three times per architecture with different checksums; we read the copy it serves. Each build-dev apk holds one regular file, /usr/bin/build, plus its directories and no symlinks, and /usr/bin/build is a Go program in every build (it carries Go build information). No build of build-dev ships uv or any other Rust program, so the crate is not in this package.

We listed the contents of every build-fips-dev apk in the Alpine 3.23 index of the authenticated DHI Alpine security repository, where the FIPS packages are published, for x86_64 and aarch64 (91 versions from 2.6.4-r0 to 2.30.0-r0, 181 apks, with 2.6.4-r0 published for aarch64 only), each checked against its index checksum. No build of build-fips-dev ships uv or any other Rust program, so the crate is not in this package.

RUSTSEC-2026-0372: the zvariant_derive crate is no longer maintained as a separate crate; its derive macros are provided by zbus from 6.0.0. RustSec marks every zvariant_derive release as affected, reports no vulnerability in it and lists no patched version: https://rustsec.org/advisories/RUSTSEC-2026-0372.html and https://github.com/z-galaxy/zbus/issues/2043. We listed the contents of every build-fips apk in the Alpine 3.23 index of the authenticated DHI Alpine security repository, where the FIPS packages are published, for x86_64 and aarch64 (91 versions from 2.6.4-r0 to 2.30.0-r0, 181 apks, with 2.6.4-r0 published for aarch64 only), each checked against its index checksum. The repository lists 2.19.1-r1 three times per architecture with different checksums; we read the copy it serves. build-fips carries the Go program /usr/bin/build in every build, from 2.26.2-r1 also the Go program /opt/docker/dhi/yq and from 2.28.0-r1 also the Go program /usr/bin/dhi-source. From 2.27.1-r1 to 2.30.0-r0 (12 versions) it also carries /opt/docker/dhi/uv, the uv 0.13.6 Rust program; these builds hold five distinct uv binaries per architecture, and every shipped copy matches one of them by SHA-256. The builds before 2.27.1-r1 carry no Rust program. The crate list that cargo-auditable embeds in each uv binary names zvariant_derive 5.11.0, used only by zvariant 5.11.0. zvariant_derive is a procedural-macro crate, with proc-macro = true in its Cargo.toml at https://docs.rs/crate/zvariant_derive/5.11.0/source/Cargo.toml and the Rust compiler runs it while uv is built; it is not linked into the uv program. No distinct uv binary contains the name zvariant_derive or zvariant-derive, while the same byte search finds zvariant-5.11.0/src source paths (10 times) and zbus-5.15.0/src source paths (91 times) in each. The zvariant_derive code is not present in any build of this package.
